versionDescription: Add Load Financial Metrics and net_cash_debt fact from XBRL metrics (E7).

parameters.query: SELECT fm.metric_key, fm.metric_value, fm.currency, fm.unit, fm.assumption_set, fm.source_evidence_id, fm.calculation_notes, fp.period_label, fp.period_end, fp.period_start, fp.fiscal_year, fp.fiscal_quarter FROM financial_metrics fm JOIN financial_periods fp ON fp.id = fm.financial_period_id WHERE fp.case_id = $1::uuid OR fp.company_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM($2), ''), 'null')::uuid ORDER BY fp.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, fm.metric_key ASC
